name: Claude Code

surfaces.name: CLI, desktop Code tab, IDE extensions: skill folder
Plugin from this repository's marketplace
steps: python -m pip install -r requirements.txt (once, for the engine)

prerequisites: Python 3.10+ and Chromium for the engine

docs.title: Agent Skills (Claude Code)
docs.facts: Personal skills in ~/.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md, project skills in .claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md; plugins bundle skills under skills/.

install.evidence: install.py put the skill in ~/.claude/skills (also through install.sh over a copy left by the old installer); claude plugin validate passes on the repository manifest; docs/hosts/EVIDENCE.md#claude-code

discovery.evidence: Claude Code 2.1.292 lists reverse-design in its skills and slash commands at session start; docs/hosts/EVIDENCE.md#claude-code

invocation.evidence: in two fresh claude -p sessions the model's first call was Skill(reverse-design); docs/hosts/EVIDENCE.md#claude-code

scan.evidence: session A: intake, profile/ink/edges measurements, role colours, annotate_scan, validate_model VALID on a 1080x1350 poster (a scan of 5 categories, as asked; full 16-category scans are covered by acceptance T01/T02); docs/hosts/EVIDENCE.md#claude-code

persistence.evidence: session A exported a bundle; session B, a new process with an empty store, fetched it by name and read its passport; docs/hosts/EVIDENCE.md#claude-code

editing.evidence: session B: 'change only the headline … keep everything else' committed; only nodes.n-headline.content changed; 0 pixels changed outside the headline against the approved baseline; docs/hosts/EVIDENCE.md#claude-code
